metadata.description: Azure region for the deployment.
Workload identifier. Used in CAF-pattern names. Lowercase alphanumeric.
Environment. One of dev, test, stage, prod.
Three-digit zero-padded instance number.
CAF mandatory tag set + operator additions. Merged into every resource.
Override the resource group name. Empty = derive from CAF pattern.
Additional tags merged with commonTags for the resource group only.
Deployment timestamp recorded in the DeployedAt tag. Defaults to UTC now.
Default container image tag. Used for both API and portal unless overridden.
Optional override for the API image tag. Empty = use imageTag. Use when the API repo has shipped a fix that the portal repo has not.
Optional override for the portal image tag. Empty = use imageTag. Portal repo has its own commit history; pin independently when SHAs diverge.
PostgreSQL administrator login.
PostgreSQL Flexible Server SKU name.
PostgreSQL Flexible Server SKU tier.
PostgreSQL storage size in GB.
PostgreSQL major version.
PostgreSQL backup retention in days.
PostgreSQL high availability mode. ZoneRedundant requires postgresSkuTier=GeneralPurpose or MemoryOptimized. Incompatible with Burstable.
PostgreSQL geo-redundant backup. Enable for prod workloads. Disabled for dev to save cost.
PostgreSQL public network access. Disabled requires private endpoint (Phase V VNet integration). Default is Disabled — set to Enabled only when a private endpoint is not yet in place.
Key Vault SKU.
Key Vault soft-delete retention in days.
Log Analytics workspace SKU.
Log Analytics retention in days.
Log Analytics daily data cap in GB. 0 = unlimited (not recommended for non-prod). Recommended: dev=1, stage=5, prod=-1 (unlimited + alert).
API container app CPU (cores).
API container app memory.
API container app minimum replica count. Set to 0 for dev (scale-to-zero), 1 for prod.
API container app maximum replica count.
API container app external ingress target port.
API ACA HTTP scale-out threshold (concurrent requests per replica).
ACA active revisions mode for API. Multiple enables weighted traffic split for zero-downtime deploys.
Portal container app CPU (cores).
Portal container app memory.
Portal container app minimum replica count. Set to 0 for dev (scale-to-zero), 1 for prod.
Portal container app maximum replica count.
Portal container app external ingress target port.
Portal ACA HTTP scale-out threshold (concurrent requests per replica).
Optional Entra tenant ID for OIDC pre-seed. Empty = ADR-047 first-run wizard.
Optional Entra client ID for OIDC pre-seed.
Optional Entra client secret. Empty when first-run wizard is used.
Entra authority base URL. Override for sovereign clouds. Default = https://login.microsoftonline.com.
GHCR username for private image pull. Empty when images are public (ADR-046).
GHCR token for private image pull. Empty when images are public.
256-bit AES master key (base64-encoded). Must be supplied at deploy time via environment variable CLOUDGRANGE_MASTER_KEY or azd env set. Written to Key Vault; ACA reads it via KV secret reference.
Enable PgBouncer connection pooling sidecar on the API container app.
Enable Defender for Cloud Standard tier for Containers and OpenSource Relational Databases.
Enable Azure Policy assignments for required tags and PG/KV audit policies.
Enable Azure Monitor metric alert rules for ACA availability, PG CPU/storage, KV throttling.
Monthly budget alert threshold in USD. 0 = no alert.
Override Log Analytics workspace name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for the Log Analytics workspace.
Override Application Insights name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for Application Insights.
Override Azure Monitor Workspace name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for the Azure Monitor Workspace.
Override managed identity name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for the managed identity.
Override Key Vault name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for the Key Vault.
Override PostgreSQL flexible server name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for the PostgreSQL server.
Override PostgreSQL database name.
Override Container Apps Environment name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for the Container Apps Environment.
Override API container app name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for the API container app.
Override portal container app name. Empty = CAF pattern.
Additional tags for the portal container app.
Optional custom domain for the portal (e.g. app.contoso.com). Empty = use default *.azurecontainerapps.io HTTPS endpoint.
Optional custom domain for the API (e.g. api.contoso.com). Empty = use default *.azurecontainerapps.io HTTPS endpoint.

Optional resource ID of a pre-existing User-Assigned Managed Identity used to authenticate this deployment (Method B). Empty = interactive az login (Method A). This identity must hold Contributor + Role Based Access Control Administrator on the target subscription. It is not used at runtime — runtime identity is the workload UAMI created by the resources module.
Existing resource IDs to reuse instead of creating new resources. Empty string = create new.

metadata.description: Azure region.
Workload identifier. Used in CAF-pattern names.
Environment.
Three-digit zero-padded instance number.
Three-letter Azure region code.
CAF mandatory tag set + operator additions. Applied to every resource.
Auto-injected tags (ManagedBy, DeployedAt). Applied to every resource.
Default container image tag. Used for API and portal unless overridden.
Optional override for the API image tag. Empty = use imageTag.
Optional override for the portal image tag. Portal repo has its own commit history so this lets you pin to a real portal SHA independently. Empty = use imageTag.
PostgreSQL admin login.
PostgreSQL geo-redundant backup. Enable for prod workloads (requires paired region).
PostgreSQL public network access. Disabled requires private endpoint (Phase V).
Log Analytics daily data cap in GB. 0 = unlimited (not recommended for non-prod).
API ACA scale-out threshold: concurrent HTTP requests per replica before adding a replica.
ACA active revisions mode. Multiple enables weighted traffic split for zero-downtime deploys.
Portal ACA scale-out threshold: concurrent HTTP requests per replica.
Entra tenant ID — empty = ADR-047 first-run wizard.
Entra client ID — empty = first-run wizard.
Entra authority base URL. Override for sovereign clouds (GovCloud, China). Default = https://login.microsoftonline.com.
GHCR username. Empty = images public (ADR-046).
256-bit AES master key (base64-encoded). Written to KV at deploy time; referenced by ACA via KV secret reference. Generated externally and passed via environment or @secure() parameter.
Enable PgBouncer connection pooling sidecar on the API container app.
Enable Azure Monitor metric alert rules for ACA availability, PG CPU/storage, KV throttling.
Optional custom domain for the portal. Empty = use default *.azurecontainerapps.io HTTPS.
Optional custom domain for the API. Empty = use default *.azurecontainerapps.io HTTPS.
